title: Backup and restore
intro: A backup holds all workflows with their versions, agent templates, tools, knowledge files, memory, runs and settings in one ZIP file.
noKey: For security no API keys of the AI providers are written into a backup. Restoring keeps the keys configured on this computer.
localText: Before every restore Nodestro automatically saves a backup of the previous state.
valid: “{{name}}” is a valid backup from {{date}}. All files are complete and undamaged.
versions: Created with Nodestro {{nodestro}} and agent library {{library}}.

notes.other_version: The backup comes from another Nodestro version. It is taken over on restore; check your workflows briefly afterwards.

replaceWarning: Restoring replaces all current data with the state of the backup.
safetyNote: The current state is backed up automatically first; afterwards you find it in the list of safety backups.
confirm: I understand that my current data will be replaced.
restored: Backup restored. The previous state is in “{{name}}”. The page reloads.
